tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Find tracked repositories by text, category/topic and language. Most popular means total stars. Stable server-side sorting happens before pagination.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Read one stored repository, its latest measured growth and health. Optional history uses stored star snapshots; it never calls GitHub. Check as_of and last_synced_at before citing counts.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Ranked recent star growth in the latest measured ranking week. window=30d returns 30-day growth and rank. Returned ranks are site-wide, even when filtering by category/topic.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Discover populated categories and GitHub topics, repository counts and canonical /c/ URLs. An unbounded request retains the complete catalog for compatibility; use limit/offset for tool calls.
